summary: Activision and David Crane's Pitfall! is a landmark Atari 2600 platformer with many ports, compilations, and later sequels/remakes.

entries.title: Pitfall!

emulation.emulator: Atari 2600 emulator only if hardware capture is unavailable
emulation.notes: Original joystick/hardware preferred for strict fidelity.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original Atari 2600 cartridge behavior with controller/difficulty switch documented

primary.version: Original cartridge or accurate Atari 2600 emulation
primary.why: Pitfall! is fundamentally an Atari 2600 game, and the original hardware/emulation route preserves its 20-minute treasure-hunt pacing, controls, and screen layout. Activision Anthology and hidden unlocks are useful access routes, but there is no clean modern storefront replacement for the original cartridge experience.
primary.how_to_play: Use an original Atari 2600 cartridge or accurate emulation from an owned copy. Record hardware/emulator, controller, difficulty switch state, timer, treasure count, score, route, lives, and whether Activision Anthology or hidden unlock versions were used.

secondary.what_to_play: Use if original hardware/cartridge is not practical.
secondary.why: It preserves access but changes wrapper, display, and input context.

all_releases.fidelity: Compilation route for the Atari 2600 game.
all_releases.reason: secondary: practical access route when cartridge capture is unavailable.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Original Atari 2600 hardware/emulation and later compilations differ in display/input wrapper.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record route/timer/treasure state and do not merge with later Pitfall sequels or mobile reboots.
